title: Question node
description: One node in a paper's question tree. Level 1 = 'QUESTION n' (holds total_marks), deeper levels are sub-questions. Shared context (stem, figures, table) lives once on the highest node it applies to; the app shows a leaf with all ancestor stems/figures/tables. Leaves carry marks, answer_type, topic and skills.

parent.description: id of the parent node, null for QUESTION n

stem_md.description: Shared context for this node and all descendants. Markdown + KaTeX ($...$).

text_md.description: The instruction/question itself. Markdown + KaTeX. Null for pure container nodes.

marks.description: Marks for an answerable node (leaf). Null on containers.

total_marks.description: Printed [n] total; only on level-1 nodes.

skills.description: 1-3 skill ids (taxonomy/skills.json) on leaves; empty on containers

cognitive_level.description: CAPS level 1-4 (knowledge, routine, complex, problem solving). Filled from memos later.

memo_ref.description: Pointer into the memo file once memos are extracted
